name: Keeper Hester

intro.text: Welcome to the crypt, love. Mind the step, it's Roman. So's the draught.
I've led the ghost walk for thirty years. The ghosts and I have an understanding. You and I are about to have one too.

win: Well. The tenth Stone. They'll be talking about this on the walk for years. Mostly the ghosts.
after: Every Stone on the islands, in one bag. The Moot will want a word.
